text.tspan: Share of the population in poverty vs. Electoral Democracy Index 2025
Poverty is defined as living on less than $10 a day. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living
costs between countries. The electoral democracy index is by V-Dem, based on expert estimates, and ranges
